definition: A process event in which relational mismatch produces a coupling reorganization that results in an orientation update.

formal_candidate.reading: A change in coupling organization produces a change in orientation organization, which updates admissibility.

recoupling.definition: A change in admissible relational coupling organization.
recoupling.implicit_condition: asymmetry is implicit because coupling change requires nonzero mismatch

reorientation.definition: The resulting update from one active orientation organization to another.

trigger.definition: Recoupling-reorientation occurs when relational mismatch exceeds the current admissible coupling tolerance.

zero_state_relation.statement: Zero-State is not admissible to the distinction domain unless it undergoes asymmetric recoupling.
zero_state_relation.note: This establishes recoupling as the entry mechanism from fully decoupled zero-DOF condition into the distinction domain.

non_equivalences: reorientation is not random direction change
zero-state recoupling is not creation from nonexistence
remaining_hardening: Define whether τ_C is local, global, or domain-relative.
Test whether RRE preserves residue lineage under orientation update.
